== Biography ==
Margaret was born before 1783. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1321|Alexander Glasgow]] and [[Cunninghame-96|Agnes Cunninghame]]. 

May be the same person as [[Glasgow-518|Margaret Glasgow (abt.1788-1874)]], 5th cousin of M Glasgow.
